# SECURITY ZONES The Commanding Officer divides the colony into four zones. Changes are posted on the front page and may come at any shift change. Where a sign and a sentry disagree, the sentry is right.
## ZONE GREEN [color=#8FB35A][bold]OPEN[/bold][/color] - Living blocks, the mess, shops, the clinic waiting room and the bar. - No checks. Patrols pass through. Carry your ID anyway.
## ZONE AMBER [color=#E3B341][bold]CONTROLLED[/bold][/color] - Landing pads, fuel stores, the power plant, the atmosphere and water works, the comms relay and Colony Administration. - ID checked at the door. Bags may be searched. No loitering, no photographs.
## ZONE RED [color=#D9654A][bold]RESTRICTED[/bold][/color] - The garrison compound, armoury, vehicle park, command post and the perimeter fence line. - Entry only under escort with a written pass. Sentries are authorised to use force to stop an intruder.
## ZONE BLACK [color=#F2EFE0][bold]EXCLUSION[/bold][/color] - Declared during an emergency: a gas leak, a fire, a cave-in, a quarantine, unexploded charges or a firefight. - Nobody crosses the cordon, colonist or Marine, unless assigned to the response. When the air is bad, the line is the line.
## MARKINGS - Chevron striping on a barrier marks the edge of a zone. - Hazard striping marks a checkpoint lane. Stop at the painted bar. - Flashing amber lights on a cordon mean Zone Black. Turn around.
Zone changes are also carried by the [netlink="Colony Herald" link="herald.colony.news"] when the press is on shift.
